purpose: Test a constant per-axis response bias on the existing exposed traces; no deployment or calibration approval.
trace_scope: The same eighteen pinned integration traces and all three whole-map folds in nav043_motion_response_proposal_v1; duplicates and prior exposure retained.

model.equation: q_next = a * q_previous + b * u + d, independently for vx, vy and planar yaw rate
model.state: SE(2) log of an already completed 0.1-second pose interval, not endpoint instantaneous body velocity or body wz
model.initial_response: zero, exactly matched to v1 diagnostic; no new claim about warmup state observability
model.integration: Once-aligned free prediction at 200 Hz; no intermediate truth correction; partial terminal intervals retained but excluded from fitting

diagnostic_gate.baseline: Already audited v1 response model, not the ideal integrator
diagnostic_gate.meaning: Prospective engineering screening on exposed <=45-second traces. No independent generalization, old delta, 90-second or G5 approval.

execution.approval: CaMRA/navigation/config/nav043_affine_response_approval_v2.json and matching pin required before trajectory reads
execution.retry: none; preserve first error/HELD, no directory changes, no quota transfer
execution.stop: invalid axis fit or execution error stops immediately; completed diagnostic gate failure stops downstream work

protection: Fixed complete v2, original power/footprint/alpha/delta, all original 45-second models/failures, readonly reference projects/manuscripts, and final_* isolation unchanged.
downstream: Diagnostic only. Observable state/warmup capture, independently versioned observation, executable reference program, 90-second residual protocol and finite learning/physical allocations remain separate prerequisites.
